asked: # Build: Plan Studio (Angel profile, Opus, one session, no sub-agents) axHub tool allowed: load CLAUDE.md, the shared + repo RULES.md and THREADS.md (claude-sync, else axhub.memory_read), then build. Branch claude/plans. Big build: split into orchestrator steps of 30 min or less, commit + push after each. Brett (voice, Oct 30): a planning studio to store and view all plans, "really powerful": enter plans by hand in the UI carrying all the info needed, categorized; and list every plugin and app with its features, checked off as have or planned. Every plugin and app needs a place in it. 1. Plugin Plan Studio (folder plan-studio, plugin-lifecycle@1, dataDir synced to axHub _data so claude.ai/VPS sessions read and write plans via axhub.memory_read/write). Contract plan@1 (JSON + Markdown body): schema, fixtures, migrations. 2. A plan carries: title, summary, goal, why; nested categories (Categories editor: add/rename/move/merge) + tags; project, plugins/apps it touches (picked from the Catalog), build profile; status idea/draft/parked/ready/building/done/dropped, priority P0-P3, effort + cost (summed from steps), target date, owner; steps (model Fable/Opus/Sonnet, estimate, dependencies, done); requirements, acceptance checklist, decisions, open questions, risks, out of scope; links (related plans depends/blocks/part-of, PRs, branches, builds, docs, URLs); attachments (images, files, voice notes, transcribed if a dictation capability exists); Markdown body with preview + outline; versioned history with diff + restore; comments. 3. Hand entry is the core: full sectioned editor, autosave drafts, phone-friendly; templates (Feature, Plugin, App, Product, Fix, Research, Refactor + user templates); quick capture (+ from banner, menu, search, right-click); AI assist via assistant@1 if installed (fill in from note, break into steps, estimate, find related), always shown as a diff to accept or reject; duplicate check on save. 4. Views: collapsible tree with multi-select, grid with expandable panes, sub-grids by category/status/project/tag/priority, board by status (drag), roadmap timeline, reader. Search all fields, filters, sort, saved views, counts, bulk actions. Phone-first, theme tokens only, framework controls, DESIGN-LANGUAGE page heads. 5. Turn into a build: pick profile, preview steps, orchestrator.mjs act add, link both ways; live progress; done when the build completes. Import/export Markdown + JSON. 6. Import as parked plans: (a) Docs Studio from _claude/memory/docs/docs-engine-plan.md on branch claude/project-thread-y4x54r (all 15 steps, models, ~7 h, 5 layouts; category Framework > Docs), then close draft PR #159 with "Moved to Plan Studio as the parked plan Docs Studio" (keep the branch). Do NOT build Docs Studio. (b) "AmberX — Selling It: Product + Installer Plan" (https://claude.ai/artifact/MGWAVAP3kfMEZtN6L5TqWf; if unreadable, title + note to paste it), category Product > Installer. (c) other parked items that are plans. 7. Catalog: an entry for every console plugin, every app in apps/, every framework library, and axHub, found automatically (same discovery as plugins.mjs / app-bundle.mjs / tracker; new ones appear with no code change, removed ones marked gone). Each entry: kind, version, status, description, profile, links, and features checked as have / partial / planned (linked to its plan or build) / idea, with counts and progress. Read features from the Feature matrix plugin, tracker.json and catalog.json as source of truth; don't duplicate them; write planned features back through that path. "Plan this" on a feature makes a pre-filled plan; a plan's chosen features show as planned and tick to have when its build finishes. Views: tree with checkboxes, expandable grid, sub-grids, coverage matrix; filters (gaps, planned, profile). 8. CLI plans.mjs add|list|show|status|import|export; capability plans@1.
